description.en:
Sets one participant of the next skill scene from the players on the pitch (CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_CHARAM_BY_IDX).
Sets one participant of the next skill scene from the players on the pitch in the current match: the player in slot posIdx of the team's pitch slots (counted from the team's first slot) gives the parameter ID, then it works like CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_CHARAM with that team. A team of 2 or more, or a slot out of range, gives character 0.
Side of the skill scene: "ATK" (attacking side) or "DEF" (defending side).
Participant number on that side, starting at 1.
Team slot: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent.
Slot number within the team's pitch slots, from 0.

examples.case: The player's first pitch slot as the defender (real usage, from ev44020012.nut)
